adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration loops through `records.each do |h|` (derived from the stored `site_settings` value `embeddable_hosts`) and performs `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)"`. This directly interpolates `h` into SQL without quoting/escaping. A host value containing a single-quote will break the SQL, and because the value comes from the database (not validated at this point), it is an injection vector within the migration context. Using bound parameters or creating records via ActiveRecord would avoid this.
